blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Digital zoom transitions between dual cameras often exhibit conspicuous discontinuities in geometric structure and chromatic consistency, degrading the user experience.
While recent dual-camera smooth zoom (DCSZ) methods attempt to mitigate this by fine-tuning frame interpolation (FI) models on DCSZ data, they struggle with the large cross-view disparities and complex geometric transformations.
Considering that the generative prior of diffusion models is suitable for addressing this problem, we explore their application to DCSZ.
However, naively applying existing diffusion-based FI models still yields low-fidelity transitions due to insufficient conditional guidance, high-frequency information loss during VAE encoding, as well as inadequate temporal consistency.
To address this, we propose ZoomDiff, a high-fidelity diffusion model that leverages dual-camera inputs in both latent and pixel spaces for photo-realistic transitions.
Specifically, we first strengthen dual-image conditional guidance during the multi-step denoising process to improve geometric consistency.
Then we inject flow-aligned multi-scale features from the VAE encoder into the VAE decoder to recover high-frequency details, where flow-guided temporal consistency supervision are introduced to produce more smooth transitions.
Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that ZoomDiff outperforms state-of-the-art methods quantitatively and qualitatively.
Project page: https://jiayi-hit.github.io/ZoomDiff.github.io/ .
blocks.zh:
双相机之间的数字缩放过渡往往在几何结构和色谱一致性方面显示出明显的不连续性,从而降低了用户的经验。
虽然最近的双相机平滑缩放(DCSZ)方法试图通过在DCSZ数据上微调框架插值(FI)模型来缓解这种情况,但它们却与巨大的交叉视差和复杂的几何变换存在困难.
考虑到传播模式之前的遗传性适合于解决这一问题,我们探索将其应用于DCSZ。
然而,由于条件引导不足,VAE编码过程中出现高频信息丢失,以及时间一致性不足,天真地应用现有的传播基FI模型仍然产生低可靠性的过渡.
为了解决这个问题,我们提出ZoomDiff,一种高真实度的传播模型,利用双相机在潜在和像素空间中的输入,实现光现实化的过渡。
具体地说,我们首先在多步骤解密过程中加强双像条件指导,以提高几何一致性.
之后我们从VAE编码器中注入流量对齐的多尺度特性到VAE解码器中以回收高频细节,其中引入流导时间一致性监督,以产生更平稳的过渡.
对合成和现实世界数据集的广泛实验表明,ZoomDiff在数量和质量上都超过了最新方法。

blocks.en:
Modern phones are equipped with multiple fixed-focal-length cameras for digital zoom.
Taking the dual-camera system as an example, it consists of a wide-angle (W) lens for primary imaging and an ultra-wide-angle (UW) lens for an even wider view.
Due to the distinct deployment locations and internal characteristics ( Zhang et al. 2022 ; Lee et al. 2022 ; Alzayer et al. 2023 ; Abdelhamed et al. 2021 ) of the two cameras, a notable preview jump in geometric content and image color occurs when zooming between them, which significantly affects the user experience as they generally prefer a fluid preview.
blocks.zh:
现代手机配备多台固定焦长相机用于数字缩放.
以双相机系统为例,它由用于初级成像的广角(W)镜头和用于更宽视野的超广角(UW)镜头组成.
由于部署地点和内部特点不同(张等2022年;李等). 2022; Alzayer et al. 2023; Abdelhamed et al. 2021) 两台相机的几何内容和图像颜色的显著预览跳动在它们之间放大时发生,这显著地影响了用户体验,因为他们一般喜欢流体预览.

blocks.en:
To explore the issue, ( Wu et al. 2024 ) first formulated that task as dual-camera smooth zoom (DCSZ), and tackled it from a data-centric perspective.
They proposed a data construction pipeline based on 3DGS ( Kerbl et al. 2023 ) , which generates synthetic DCSZ data to fine-tune a frame interpolation (FI) model for smooth transitions.
However, the results generally suffer from noticeable visual artifacts, which severely undermine the perceptual quality and zooming consistency.
We argue that the main cause lies in the inherent model-task mismatch.
Specifically, mainstream optical-flow-based ( Li et al. 2023 ; Cheng and Chen 2021 ; Kong et al. 2022 ; Huang et al. 2022 ; Jin et al. 2023 ) or diffusion-based ( Zhu et al. 2025 ; Wang et al. 2024a ; Wang et al. 2024b ; Feng et al. 2024 ; Wan et al. 2025 ) FI models are designed for videos with smaller camera or object motion, which cannot adapt to the large cross-view disparity and complex geometric transformations between dual cameras.
In other words, a task-specific FI model tailored for the DCSZ task should be elaborately designed.
blocks.zh:
为了探讨这一问题,(Wu等人,2024年)首先将这项任务定为双相机平滑缩放(DCSZ),并从以数据为中心的角度加以解决。
他们提出了基于3DGS(Kerbl等人,2023年)的数据构建管道,该管道生成合成的DCSZ数据,以微调一个框架插值(FI)模型,用于平稳过渡.
然而,结果一般都受到显著的视觉文物的影响,严重损害了视觉质量和放大一致性。
我们提出,主要原因是固有的模型任务不匹配。
具体而言,主流光学流(Li等人)。 2023; 程和陈 2021; 孔等. 2022; 黄等. 2022 ; Jin等人 2023 )或基于传播(Zhu等人. 2025; 王等编. 2024a; 王等编. 2024b; 冯等. 2024 ; Wan et al. 2025) FI模型是针对摄像头或物体运动较小的视频设计的,无法适应双摄像头之间的大跨视差和复杂的几何转换.
换句话说,应精心设计适合DCSZ任务的具体任务的FI模型。

blocks.en:
Compared to optical-flow-based ( Li et al. 2023 ; Cheng and Chen 2021 ; Kong et al. 2022 ; Huang et al. 2022 ; Jin et al. 2023 ) interpolation manners, diffusion-based ones ( Zhu et al. 2025 ; Wang et al. 2024a ; Wang et al. 2024b ; Feng et al. 2024 ; Wan et al. 2025 ) are more suited for such large cross-view transitions, due to the powerful generative prior.
However, naively applying them still encounters challenges in achieving high-fidelity transitions.
On the one hand, the insufficient utilization of dual-camera images as conditional guidance in the diffusion process leads to obvious spatial artifacts and color shift in the synthesized intermediate frames.
On the other hand, note that the VAE encoding process ( Rombach et al. 2022 ) inevitably incurs high-frequency information loss.
As illustrated in Fig. 1 , images reconstructed from the VAE latent space contain less fine-grained details compared to the original ones.
Thus, only utilizing dual images in the latent space is insufficient to achieve high-fidelity zooming.
blocks.zh:
与光学流基(Li等人. 2023; 程和陈 2021; 孔等. 2022; 黄等. 2022; 龚等. 2023) 内插方式,传播方式(朱等. 2025; 王等编. 2024a; 王等编. 2024b; 冯等. 2024; Wan et al. 2025)更适合这样的大跨视过渡,因为强力的基因前传.
然而,天真地应用这些工具,在实现高度诚信过渡方面仍然面临挑战。
一方面,双相机图像在扩散过程中作为有条件的导线利用不足,导致合成中间框明显出现空间文物和色变.
另一方面,注意VAE编码过程(Rombach等人,2022年)不可避免地会发生高频信息损失.
如图1所示,从VAE潜在空间重建的图像与原始图像相比,包含的精细细节较少。
因此,只有利用潜在空间的双重图像不足以实现高真实度放大。

blocks.en:
In this work, we propose ZoomDiff, a high-fidelity diffusion model for achieving smooth zoom between dual cameras, where the dual-camera images are fully employed in both latent and image spaces to address the aforementioned limitations.
On the one hand, in the latent space, the dual-camera latents are directly concatenated with the input noise on the endpoints and fed into the denoising network, while their semantic features are incorporated via cross-attention mechanisms.
Additionally, to prevent error accumulation between the predicted dual-camera latents and the original ones during multi-step denoising, we explicitly replace the predicted dual-camera latents with the original ones at each denoising step.
On the other hand, in the image space, we note that the multi-scale feature maps extracted by the VAE encoder preserve more high-frequency details, and their appropriate utilization is important for improving fidelity.
As the VAE encoding features of intermediate frames are unavailable, we first employ a pre-trained optical flow estimation network (e.g., SEA-RAFT ( Wang et al. 2024c ) ) to estimate the motion between dual-camera images and the intermediate frames.
Then we warp the dual-image features to obtain features for the intermediate frames, which are injected into the VAE decoder via a ref injector module for better generation.
Besides, flow-guided temporal consistency supervision is adopted to produce more smooth transitions.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们提出ZoomDiff,一种实现双相机间平滑缩放的高真度扩散模型,其中双相机图像在潜伏空间和图像空间中都得到充分利用,以应对上述局限性.
一方面,在潜伏的空间中,双相机潜伏物与端点上的输入噪声直接交织在一起,并输入去诺化网络,而它们的语义特征则通过交叉留念机制进行融合.
此外,为防止预测的双相机潜伏物和原相机在多步骤去诺时发生误差积累,我们明确将预测的双相机潜伏物替换为每次去诺时的原相机.
另一方面,在图像空间中,我们注意到由VAE编码器提取的多比例特征图保存了更多的高频细节,它们的适当利用对于提高忠诚度很重要.
由于中间帧的VAE编码特征是没有的,我们首先使用一个经过预先训练的光学流估计网络(如SEA-RAFT(Wang等人,2024c))来估计双相机图像与中间帧之间的运动.
然后,我们将双像特性转换,以获得中间帧的特性,这些特性通过一个还原注射模块注入VAE解码器,以更好地生成.
此外,还采用了流动制导的时间一致性监督,以产生更平稳的过渡。

blocks.en:
We conduct extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
The results demonstrate that our ZoomDiff achieves photo-realistic smooth zooming between dual cameras, outperforming state-of-the-art methods both quantitatively and qualitatively.
The contributions can be summarized as follows: • We propose ZoomDiff, a high-fidelity diffusion model for achieving smooth zoom transitions between dual cameras. • We suggest injecting the dual-camera images in both latent and image spaces, where latent information from the dual images is used in multiple ways to guide the denoising process for geometric consistency, while flow-aligned multi-scale features from the VAE encoder are injected into the VAE decoder to preserve high-frequency details. • Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of ZoomDiff, outperforming state-of-the-art methods.
blocks.zh:
我们对合成和现实世界的数据集进行广泛的实验。
结果显示,我们的ZoomDiff在双相机之间实现了光现实平滑的缩放,在数量和质量上都超过了最先进的方法。
这些贡献可归纳如下: 我们提出ZoomDiff,一种实现双相机间平滑缩放过渡的高真度传播模型. ^ 我们建议将双相机图像注入潜伏空间和图像空间,其中双相机中潜伏信息以多种方式用于引导去诺化过程实现几何一致性,而VAE编码器中的流调多尺度特征则注入VAE解码器,以保存高频细节. • 对合成和现实世界数据集进行的广泛实验表明ZoomDiff的效能,其性能超过最先进的方法。

blocks.en: Dual-Camera Smooth Zoom
blocks.zh: 双镜头平滑缩放

blocks.en:
They proposed a data construction pipeline based on 3DGS ( Kerbl et al. 2023 ) that generates synthetic zooming sequences between dual cameras to fine-tune video frame interpolation (VFI) models ( Li et al. 2023 ; Jin et al. 2023 ; Huang et al. 2022 ; Kong et al. 2022 ) for smooth transitions.
However, even with data-driven adaptation, the synthesized results often exhibit boundary artifacts and structural inconsistencies due to substantial geometric disparity in such extremely large cross-view transitions.
These observations highlight the difficulty of the DCSZ task, and it is necessary to design an FI model tailored to it.

blocks.en: Optical-Flow-Based Frame Interpolation
blocks.zh: 光学-流基框架内插

blocks.en:
Driven by the robustness of optical flow, flow-based manners ( Huang et al. 2022 ; Kong et al. 2022 ; Bao et al. 2019a ; Bao et al. 2019b ; Li et al. 2023 ; Jin et al. 2023 ; Liu et al. 2017 ; Niklaus and Liu 2018 ; Niklaus and Liu 2020 ; Xu et al. 2019 ; Zhang et al. 2023a ; Lu et al. 2022 ; Park et al. 2023 ) currently dominate video frame interpolation, with extensive research into novel optimization objectives ( Huang et al. 2022 ; Kong et al. 2022 ) and advanced network designs ( Bao et al. 2019a ; Bao et al. 2019b ; Li et al. 2023 ; Jin et al. 2023 ; Liu et al. 2017 ; Niklaus and Liu 2018 ; Niklaus and Liu 2020 ; Xu et al. 2019 ; Zhang et al. 2023a ; Lu et al. 2022 ; Park et al. 2023 ) .
To enhance flow accuracy, existing works have proposed various strategies, ranging from task-oriented flow distillation (e.g., RIFE ( Huang et al. 2022 ) and IFRNet ( Kong et al. 2022 ) ) and advanced bidirectional correlation retrieval (e.g., AMT ( Li et al. 2023 ) and UPRNet ( Jin et al. 2023 ) ) to unified motion-appearance extraction.
By relying on explicit motion modeling and geometric alignment, these methods excel at synthesizing temporally coherent frames under moderate motion.
However, applying them to the DCSZ task reveals fundamental limitations.
Dual-camera systems inherently introduce large cross-view disparities and progressive content occlusion.
These characteristics severely violate the strict dense correspondence assumption fundamental to optical-flow estimation.
Consequently, traditional flow-based models often fail to produce reliable matches, struggling to maintain sharp boundaries and detailed structures in the DCSZ task.
blocks.zh:
受光学流体稳健性,流体礼仪的驱使(黄等人. 2022; 孔 al等. 2022; 鲍等. 2019a; Bao et al. 2019b; 李等编. 2023; 龚等. 2023; 刘等. 2017; Niklaus and Liu 2018; Niklaus and Liu 2020; 许等人. 2019; 张等. 2023a; 吕等. 2022; Park 等人 2023)目前主导视频帧插图,广泛研究小说优化目标(Huang et al. 2022; Kong等人 2022)和高级网络设计(Bao等人 2019a; 宝等. 2019b; 李等编. 2023; 龚等. 2023; 刘等. 2017; Niklaus and Liu 2018; Niklaus and Liu 2020; 许等人. 2019; 张等. 2023a; Lu等人 2022; Park等人 2023 ).
为了提高流量精度,现有作品提出了各种战略,从面向任务的流量蒸馏(如RIFE(黄等人,2022年)和IFRNet(Kong等人,2022年)),以及先进的双向关联检索(如AMT(李等人,2023年)和UPRNet(Jin等人,2023年))到统一的运动出现提取.
这些方法依靠明确的运动模型和几何对齐,在中度运动下合成时间上一致的帧。
然而,将它们应用到DCSZ任务中暴露出根本的局限性.
双相机系统本身就引入了巨大的跨视角差异和渐进内容隔离.
这些特性严重违反了对光学流估计至关重要的严格密密的函证假设。
因此,传统的流动模式往往无法产生可靠的匹配,难以维持DCSZ任务中的尖锐界限和详细结构。

blocks.en: Diffusion-Based Frame Interpolation
blocks.zh: 基于传播的框架

blocks.en:
Recent works have extensively explored diffusion models ( Zhu et al. 2025 ; Wang et al. 2024a ; Wang et al. 2024b ; Feng et al. 2024 ; Yang et al. 2024 ; Wan et al. 2025 ) for generative frame interpolation without explicitly relying on optical flow.
Representative methods, such as FCVG ( Zhu et al. 2025 ) , GI ( Wang et al. 2024b ) , and TRF ( Feng et al. 2024 ) , formulate this as a conditional generation task by encoding the first and last frames as conditions for the denoising network.
Furthermore, approaches such as VIBID ( Yang et al. 2024 ) , Framer ( Wang et al. 2024a ) , and the recent video foundation model Wan2.1 (FLF) ( Wan et al. 2025 ) harness the rich generative priors of large-scale diffusion models, employing advanced temporal modules to synthesize coherent intermediate dynamics.
By leveraging these generative capabilities, they can hallucinate plausible structures under large appearance changes, fundamentally alleviating the strict correspondence assumptions of flow-based methods.
However, naively applying existing diffusion-based FI models for the DCSZ task yields low-fidelity transitions, due to insufficient conditional guidance and high-frequency information loss during VAE encoding.
In this work, we propose ZoomDiff, a high-fidelity diffusion model that utilizes dual-camera inputs in both latent and pixel spaces for photo-realistic transitions.
blocks.zh:
近期的著作广泛探索了传播模式(朱等人. 2025; 王等编. 2024a; 王等编. 2024b; 冯等. 2024; 杨等. 2024 ; Wan等人 2025 )用于基因框架插值,而没有明确依赖光学流.
FCVG(Zhu et al. 2025),GI(Wang et al. 2024b),TRF(Feng et al. 2024)等代表方法,通过将第一帧和最后一帧编码为去诺化网络的条件,来制定这个条件生成任务.
此外,VIBID(Yang 等人,2024年),Framer(Wang等人,2024年a),以及近期的视频基础模型Wan2.1(FLF)(Wan等人,2025年)等方法利用大规模传播模型丰富的遗传学前科,采用先进的时间模块来合成连贯的中间动态.
通过利用这些基因能力,它们可以在巨大的外观变化下产生假象结构,从根本上缓解了流法的严格对应假设.
然而,由于在VAE编码过程中的条件引导不足和高频信息丢失,天真地将现有的基于扩散的FI模型应用到DCSZ任务中,会产生低可靠性的过渡.
在这项工作中,我们提出ZoomDiff,一种高真实度的传播模型,利用潜在和像素空间中的双相机输入来进行光现实化过渡.

blocks.en:
Although several studies ( Zhu et al. 2025 ; Wang et al. 2024a ; Wang et al. 2024b ; Feng et al. 2024 ; Yang et al. 2024 ) have endeavored to apply diffusion models to video frame interpolation, we observe that naively applying them to DCSZ still faces challenges in achieving high-fidelity transitions, due to insufficient conditional guidance for multi-step denoising and high-frequency information loss during VAE encoding.
In this work, we propose ZoomDiff, a diffusion model based upon SVD ( Blattmann et al. 2023 ) for high-fidelity smooth zooming between dual cameras, as shown in Fig. 2 .
Specifically, we first introduce several mechanisms to strengthen the conditional guidance of dual images during the multi-step denoising process in the latent space.
Then, we explore the dual-camera images in image space by incorporating multi-scale features from the VAE encoder into the VAE decoder to preserve high-frequency details
Finally, we provide the details of optimization objectives and inference acceleration.
blocks.zh:
虽然有数项研究(朱等). 2025; 王等编. 2024a; 王等编. 2024b; 冯等. 2024; Yang 等人 2024)曾努力将传播模型应用到视频帧内插,我们观察到,天真地将其应用到DCSZ仍然面临着实现高纯度过渡的挑战,原因是在VAE编码过程中对多步解密和高频信息丢失的有条件指导不足.
在这部作品中,我们提出ZomDiff,一种基于SVD(Blattmann等人,2023年)的传播模型,用于在双相机之间高纯度平滑放大,如图2所示.
具体地说,我们首先引入了若干机制,以加强在潜在空间的多步骤消音过程中对双重图像的有条件指导。
然后,我们通过将VAE编码器的多尺度特性纳入VAE解码器来探索图像空间中的双相机图像,以保存高频细节.
最后,我们提供了优化目标和推论加速的细节。

blocks.en: Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets.
blocks.zh: 数据集.

blocks.en:
We follow ( Wu et al. 2024 ) to construct 2100 sequences, including indoor and outdoor scenes, where 2000 sequences are used for training, and the non-overlapped 100 ones are used for evaluation.
Each sequence comprises 14 frames at a resolution of 576 × 320 576\times 320 .
Besides, we use 100 real-world scenes captured by Redmi K50 Ultra from ( Wu et al. 2024 ) to evaluate performance in the real world.
blocks.zh:
我们跟随(Wu等人,2024年)构建2100个序列,包括室内和室外场景,其中2000个序列用于训练,非重叠的100个序列用于评价.
每个序列由14个帧组成,分辨率为576×320576\times 320.
此外,我们使用Redmi K50 Ultra从(Wu et al. 2024)拍摄的100幅真实世界场景来评价真实世界的表现.

blocks.en:
Training Configurations. For stable optimization, we adopt a two-stage training strategy.
In the first stage, we train the denoising U-Net for 40k iterations for coarse geometry optimization.
In the second stage, the denoising U-Net is frozen, and only the parameters of the ref injector module are optimized for an additional 10k iterations for fine-grained details.
The learning rate is set to 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} and the Adam optimizer ( Kingma and Ba 2014 ) is adopted.
We augment the training data with random horizontal and vertical flips.
All experiments are conducted with PyTorch ( Paszke et al. 2019 ) on two Nvidia GeForce RTX A6000 GPUs.
blocks.zh:
培训配置。 为了稳定优化,我们采取两阶段培训战略。
在第一阶段,我们为粗几何优化培训40k重迭的U-Net。
在第二阶段,去诺化的U-Net被冷冻,只有Ref注射器模块的参数被优化,用于额外的10k迭代,用于细纹细节.
学习率设定为3×10−5 3\times 10×5}亚当优化器(Kingma和Ba 2014)被采纳.
我们通过随机横向和纵向翻转来增加培训数据。
所有实验均与PyTorch(Paszke等人,2019年)在两个Nvidia GeForce RTX A6000 GPU上进行.

blocks.en:
Evaluation Configurations. During inference, we set the random seed to 42 42 for deterministic evaluation.
For the synthetic dataset with ground-truth intermediate frames, we calculate full-reference metrics, including PSNR ( Huynh-Thu and Ghanbari 2008 ) , SSIM ( Wang et al. 2004 ) , and LPIPS ( Zhang et al. 2018b ) for spatial fidelity, as well as PSNR-div ( Daly et al. 2025 ) and FVD ( Unterthiner et al. 2018 ) for temporal consistency evaluation.
For real-world data without ground-truth references, we employ several no-reference image and video quality assessment metrics, including MUSIQ ( Ke et al. 2021 ) , LIQE ( Zhang et al. 2023b ) , DBCNN ( Wang et al. 2023 ) , and DOVER ( Wu et al. 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:

对于带有地真中间框架的合成数据集,我们计算了全参考度量度,包括PSNR(Huynh-Thu和Ghanbari,2008年),SSIM(Wang等人,2004年)和LPIPS(Zhang等人,2018年b),以及PSNR-div(Daly等人,2025年)和FVD(Unterthiner等人,2018年)的时间一致性评价.
对于没有地面真实参考资料的真实世界数据,我们使用了若干无参考图像和视频质量评估指标,包括MUSIQ(Ke等人,2021年),LIQE(Zhang等人,2023年b),DBCNN(Wang等人,2023年)和DOVER(Wu等人,2023年).

blocks.en: Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods
blocks.zh: 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en:
Comparison Configurations .
We compare our method with 12 state-of-the-art frame interpolation methods, including 5 optical-flow-based ones (i.e., EDSC ( Cheng and Chen 2021 ) , IFRNet ( Kong et al. 2022 ) , RIFE ( Huang et al. 2022 ) , AMT ( Li et al. 2023 ) , UPRNet ( Jin et al. 2023 ) and 6 diffusion-based ones (i.e., FCVG ( Zhu et al. 2025 ) , GI ( Wang et al. 2024b ) , TRF ( Feng et al. 2024 ) , VIBID ( Yang et al. 2024 ) , Framer ( Wang et al. 2024a ) and Wan2.1 ( Wan et al. 2025 ) ).
Note that Wan2.1 ( Wan et al. 2025 ) refers to the first-last-frame-to-video version (FLF2V-14B-720P).

比较配置 。

注意Wan2.1(Wan等人,2025年)是指第一帧对视频版本(FLF2V-14B-720P).

blocks.en:
Quantitative Results .
Table 1 presents the quantitative comparison against state-of-the-art methods.
On the synthetic dataset, ZoomDiff achieves the best reconstruction fidelity and temporal consistency, outperforming all competitors with PSNR of 23.80, SSIM of 0.761, LPIPS of 0.253, PSNR-div of 23.01, and FVD of 131.332.
Furthermore, on the real-world dataset, ZoomDiff exhibits superior generalization capability and visual quality.
It establishes new state-of-the-art performance across all no-reference image quality assessment metrics.
Overall, these results validate the superiority of ZoomDiff over existing methods for generating high-fidelity, temporally consistent, and visually pleasing results in both synthetic and complex real-world scenarios.

量化结果
表1显示与最新方法的定量比较。
在合成数据集上,ZoomDiff实现了最佳的重建忠诚度和时间一致性,以23.80的PSNR,0.761的SSIM,0.253的LPIPS,23.01的PSNR-div和131.332的FVD,超越了所有竞争对手.
此外,在现实世界的数据集上,ZoomDiff展现出优异的概括能力和视觉质量.
它确立了所有无参考图像质量评估指标的最新业绩。
总的来说,这些结果证实了ZoomDiff在合成和复杂的现实世界情景中优于产生高度真实性、时间一致性和视觉取悦性的现有方法。

blocks.en:
Qualitative Results .
The qualitative comparisons on synthetic and real-world datasets are presented in Fig. 3 .
Optical-flow-based methods ( Li et al. 2023 ; Cheng and Chen 2021 ; Kong et al. 2022 ; Huang et al. 2022 ; Jin et al. 2023 ) exhibit noticeable structural artifacts, degrading the zooming consistency.
Meanwhile, diffusion-based approaches ( Zhu et al. 2025 ; Wang et al. 2024a ; Wang et al. 2024b ; Wan et al. 2025 ) generate inconsistent geometry and confusing details due to inadequate dual-camera guidance and VAE-induced high-frequency loss.
In contrast, by jointly exploiting the dual-camera information in both latent and image spaces, ZoomDiff produces geometrically consistent zoom transitions with photo-realistic details and fewer visual artifacts.
Additional video results are provided in Suppl. .

blocks.en: Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 阅读研究

blocks.en:
We conduct ablation studies to analyze the effectiveness of each component in the proposed ZoomDiff on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
Specifically, we first investigate different strategies for injecting the latents of dual-image into the diffusion process.
Then, we evaluate the effectiveness of injecting multi-scale image features from the VAE encoder into the VAE decoder.
Finally, we study the impact of optimization objectives and few-step adaptation.
blocks.zh:
我们进行消化研究,分析拟议的ZoomDiff中每个组件在合成和现实世界数据集上的有效性。
具体地说,我们首先调查将双重形象的潜伏注入传播过程的不同战略。
然后,我们评价将VAE编码器的多尺度图像特性注入VAE解码器的有效性.
最后,我们研究优化目标和几步适应的影响。

blocks.en: Effect of Dual-Image Utilization in Latent Space
blocks.zh: 后期空间双重图像利用的影响

blocks.en:
We exploit dual-image information in the latent space through three complementary designs.
First, the encoded latents of the two reference images are concatenated with the noisy latents at the first and last frames, respectively.
Second, their semantic features are injected into the denoising network through cross-attention to provide high-level structural guidance.
Third, the predicted boundary latents are replaced with the original reference latents at each denoising step, preventing errors at the two endpoints from accumulating throughout the sequence.
We validate these designs through the ablations in Table 2 .
Removing the semantic features ( i.e . , w/o Semantic) weakens structural fidelity, indicating that latent inputs alone are insufficient to preserve high-level content.
Without step-wise latent replacement ( i.e . , w/o Replacement), prediction errors at the boundary frames gradually accumulate, leading to brightness deviations and temporally propagated artifacts.
We also investigate a naive strategy that concatenates both reference latents with every noisy latent along the channel dimension ( i.e . , Naive Concat).
This indiscriminate fusion disrupts the original denoising distribution and introduces inconsistent conditioning across frames, resulting in inferior reconstruction quality and unstable brightness.
By combining semantic guidance with explicit boundary anchoring, our full model achieves the best overall performance across the synthetic and real-world datasets.
blocks.zh:
我们通过三种互补设计,利用潜在空间中的双重图像信息。
首先,两个参考图像的编码潜伏物分别与第一帧和最后一帧的噪音潜伏物相配合.
其次,他们的语义特征通过交叉意向注入去诺网络,以提供高层次的结构指导.
第三,将预测的边界潜在值替换为每个去诺步骤的原始参考潜在值,防止两个终点的错误在整个序列中积累。
我们通过表2中的拼图验证这些设计。
消除语义特征(即w/o语义)会削弱结构的忠诚性,表明潜在的投入本身不足以保护高层次的内容.
不采用阶梯式潜在置换(即w/o置换),边界框的预测误差逐渐累积,导致亮度偏差和时间传播的文物.
我们还调查了一种天真的策略,这种策略将两种潜在物与海峡维度(即Naive Concat)沿线的每一个响亮潜在物混为一谈。
这种不分青红皂白的聚变扰乱了最初的去诺化分布,引入了不连贯的跨帧调节,导致重建质量低下,亮度不稳定.
通过将语义指导与明确的边界锚定相结合,我们的完整模型在合成和现实世界数据集中实现了最佳的整体性能.

blocks.en: Effect of Dual-Image Utilization in Image Space
blocks.zh: 图像空间双重图像利用的影响

blocks.en:
To compensate for the high-frequency information lost during VAE encoding, we inject the multi-scale features of the dual-camera images from the VAE encoder into the corresponding layers of the VAE decoder.
We evaluate this design by removing the feature injection while keeping the remaining components unchanged.
The qualitative and quantitative comparisons on the synthetic and real-world datasets are presented in Fig. 4 and Table 3 , respectively.
As shown in Fig. 4 , removing the encoder features ( i.e . , w/o Injection) leads to blurred textures, weakened fine structures, and local distortions, consistent with the information loss introduced by the VAE bottleneck in Fig. 1 .
In contrast, ZoomDiff provides the decoder with complementary multi-scale information from both input images, thereby preserving spatial structures and recovering sharper and more faithful details.
The consistent improvements across the quantitative metrics in Table 3 further demonstrate the importance of utilizing dual-image information in the image space.
blocks.zh:

我们通过去除特征注入来评价这个设计,同时保持剩余组件不变.

相比之下,ZoomDiff为解码器提供了来自两个输入图像的互补的多尺度信息,从而维护了空间结构并恢复了更尖锐和更忠实的细节.

blocks.en: Effect of Optimization Objectives
blocks.zh: 优化的效果 目标

blocks.en:
We introduce ℒ l ​ a ​ t ​ e ​ n ​ t \mathcal{L}_{latent} and ℒ p ​ i ​ x ​ e ​ l \mathcal{L}_{pixel} to optimize the proposed ZoomDiff in the latent space and image space respectively, where ℒ p ​ i ​ x ​ e ​ l \mathcal{L}_{pixel} is the combination of a pixel-wise reconstruction loss ℒ m ​ s ​ e \mathcal{L}_{mse} , an LPIPS-based perceptual loss ℒ l ​ p ​ i ​ p ​ s \mathcal{L}_{lpips} , and the flow-guided temporal consistency loss ℒ f ​ t ​ c \mathcal{L}_{ftc} .
As shown in Table 4 , removing both ℒ l ​ p ​ i ​ p ​ s \mathcal{L}_{lpips} and ℒ f ​ t ​ c \mathcal{L}_{ftc} slightly improves PSNR and SSIM metrics, but degrades all perceptual metrics, demonstrating that pixel-wise supervision alone is insufficient for generating visually pleasing results.
Introducing ℒ l ​ p ​ i ​ p ​ s \mathcal{L}_{lpips} consistently improves perceptual quality, demonstrating the value of perceptual supervision for recovering fine-grained image details.
Further incorporating ℒ f ​ t ​ c \mathcal{L}_{ftc} achieves the best overall performance, validating the effectiveness of the proposed flow-guided temporal consistency supervision.
Visual comparisons in the Suppl further demonstrate that ℒ l ​ p ​ i ​ p ​ s \mathcal{L}_{lpips} helps generate more fine-grained details, while ℒ f ​ t ​ c \mathcal{L}_{ftc} effectively suppresses temporal flickering.

blocks.en: Effect of Few-Step Adaptation
blocks.zh: 几步适应的效果

blocks.en:
The iterative denoising process of diffusion models incurs substantial inference overhead. We therefore adapt the converged 25-step model to 8-step and 4-step sampling schedules without modifying the network architecture. As shown in Table 5 , the resulting models achieve 2.16 × 2.16\times and 2.92 × 2.92\times inference speedups, respectively.
Table 6 demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed adaptation. Compared with directly shortening the sampling trajectory, the adapted 8-step and 4-step models consistently improve all evaluation metrics. In particular, the adapted 8-step model surpasses the original 25-step model on all synthetic metrics while maintaining comparable performance on the real-world dataset. Although the 4-step model shows a moderate quality degradation relative to the 25-step model, it remains clearly superior to the unadapted 4-step variant. These results demonstrate that few-step adaptation substantially improves inference efficiency while preserving generation quality.

表6显示了拟议的适应的有效性。 与直接缩短采样轨迹相比,经过调整的8步和4步模型不断改进所有评价指标。 特别是,经过调整的8步模型超越了所有合成度量衡上最初的25步模型,同时保持了现实世界数据集的可比性能. 虽然4步模型相对于25步模型显示出中等质量的降解,但它仍然明显优于未适应的4步变体. 这些结果表明,很少步骤的适应在保持发电质量的同时,大大提高了推论效率。

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we present ZoomDiff, a high-fidelity diffusion framework tailored for the Dual-Camera Smooth Zoom (DCSZ) task, where the dual-camera images are fully utilized in both the latent and the image space to improve fidelity.
Specifically, we introduce multiple ways to utilize the latent information from the dual images to guide the denoising process for geometric consistency, and inject flow-aligned multi-scale features from the VAE encoder into the VAE decoder via a ref injector module to preserve high-frequency details.
Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that ZoomDiff outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving photo-realistic smooth zooming transitions between dual cameras.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们介绍了ZoomDiff,这是一个适合双卡米拉平滑缩放任务的高真度传播框架,其中双卡米拉图像在潜伏空间和图像空间都得到充分利用,以提高忠诚度。
具体地说,我们采用多种方式,利用双重图像中的潜在信息来引导去诺化过程实现几何一致性,并通过一个还原注射器模块,将VAE编码器的流配多尺度特性注入VAE解码器,以保存高频细节.
对合成和现实世界数据集的广泛实验表明,ZoomDiff的性能超过了最先进的方法,实现了双相机之间的光现实平滑放大过渡.

blocks.en: Sec.B More Ablation Results
blocks.zh: B. 更多偏差结果

blocks.en: In addition to the quantitative ablation results reported in the main paper, we provide more qualitative comparisons to analyze the effects of different design components in ZoomDiff.
blocks.zh: 除了在主论文中报告的量化减速结果外,我们还提供了更多的定性比较,以分析ZoomDiff中不同设计组件的效果.

blocks.en: Effect of Dual-Image Utilization in Latent Space
blocks.zh: 后期空间双重图像利用的影响

blocks.en:
We provide qualitative comparisons of different latent-space utilization strategies in Fig. 9 .
Compared with our full model, removing semantic guidance (i.e., w/o Semantic) results in less accurate structural details, demonstrating that high-level semantic information from the reference images is important for preserving scene content during denoising.
Without step-wise latent replacement (i.e., w/o Replacement), the boundary frames gradually deviate from the input references, causing brightness inconsistency and accumulated artifacts along the zoom trajectory.
The naive concatenation strategy (i.e., Naive Concat) introduces unstable conditioning across frames, leading to inferior visual quality and inconsistent transitions.
By effectively combining semantic guidance and boundary latent anchoring, our method generates more coherent and visually consistent zoom transitions.

不采用阶梯式潜在置换(即w/o置换),边界框逐渐偏离输入引用,导致亮度不一致,并沿缩放轨迹积累文物.
天真凝聚策略(即Naive Concat)引入了跨帧的不稳定调节,导致视觉质量低下,过渡不一致.
通过有效地结合语义引导和边界潜在锚定,我们的方法产生更加连贯和视觉一致的放大过渡。

blocks.en: Effect of Optimization Objectives
blocks.zh: 优化的效果 目标

blocks.en:
We provide additional qualitative comparisons of different loss configurations to further illustrate the effects of ℒ l ​ p ​ i ​ p ​ s \mathcal{L}_{lpips} and ℒ f ​ t ​ c \mathcal{L}_{ftc} .
The visual results in Fig. 10 and Fig. 11 highlight the complementary roles of perceptual and temporal supervision.
As shown in Fig. 10 , removing ℒ l ​ p ​ i ​ p ​ s \mathcal{L}_{lpips} leads to degraded perceptual quality, with distorted and blurry fine details in the generated frames.
Introducing ℒ l ​ p ​ i ​ p ​ s \mathcal{L}_{lpips} helps recover more realistic textures and preserve fine-grained details.
As shown in Fig. 11 , removing the proposed flow-guided temporal consistency loss ℒ f ​ t ​ c \mathcal{L}_{ftc} causes color and brightness deviations across consecutive frames, which become more apparent as the zoom transition progresses.
With ℒ f ​ t ​ c \mathcal{L}_{ftc} , the generated sequence better preserves consistent appearance and temporal coherence.

blocks.en: Sec.C More Challenging Cases
blocks.zh: C. 挑战 案例

blocks.en:
We present additional challenging cases in real-world scenarios, including human motion, large FOV changes, and severe exposure variations.
Fig. 12 (a)(i) shows a scene with dynamic human motion, where moving objects introduce additional temporal ambiguity during the zoom transition.
Fig. 12 (a)(ii) demonstrates a large FOV change between dual cameras, requiring the model to handle substantial viewpoint variation and content differences.
Fig. 12 (a)(iii) presents a case with severe exposure variation, where significant illumination discrepancies between the two cameras make consistent appearance preservation challenging.
Despite these challenging conditions, our method generates smooth transitions while maintaining strong temporal consistency and geometric coherence.
